description: Na₄Sr₂TiAs₄ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Ti and five As atoms. The Na-Ti bond length is 3.33 Å. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.17-3.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.28 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.27 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.31 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five As atoms. There are a spread of Sr-As bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.34 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five As atoms. There are a spread of Sr-As bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.38 Å. Ti is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na and four As atoms. There are a spread of Ti-As bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.52 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, two Sr, and one Ti atom. In the second As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Sr, and one Ti atom. In the third As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Sr, and one Ti atom. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Ti atom.
